title: Paused-chip x position hand-derives private layout constants of health.odin and forecast.odin — no single source
evidence: app/main.odin:260: `chip := rl.Rectangle{f32(app.view.win_w/2 + 240), 12, 120, 38}`; app/render/health.odin: `card_w := i32(440)` / `pad := i32(10)` / `x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2` / `rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, HEALTH_CARD_H, ...)` (backdrop right edge = win_w/2+230); app/render/forecast.odin: `card_w := i32(230)` / `pad := i32(10)` / `x := v.win_w - card_w - pad` (panel at x-pad → left edge win_w-250).
detail: The chip's 880–1000 slot is derived by hand from card_w/pad values private to two render modules. The tray precedent is single-source rect math (tray_chip_rect); a future card-width change silently overlaps the chip, and draw_hud draws after, hiding it.
recommended_fix: Export shared top-band layout constants (health right edge, forecast left edge) from the render package and compute the chip x from them, so overlap is impossible by construction.

title: Three 'under the veil' comments survive the veil's removal — comment/code drift
evidence: app/main.odin:193: `// fast-path edit THIS frame — the player plans under the veil, and a`; app/main.odin:220: `// under the veil — the live preview + the committed glow stay usable).`; app/main.odin:238: `// 5.3: live while paused too (demolish-and-plan under the veil).`
detail: The diff deletes the dim veil but leaves three comments describing paused planning 'under the veil'. Future readers will believe an overlay still exists, misreading the pause UX rationale the ruling changed.
recommended_fix: Update the three comments to the new presentation (full-brightness paused world, edge chip indicator).

title: Screen-anchored HUD chip drawn inline in main()'s loop; all other persistent HUD chrome lives in draw_hud/render package
evidence: main(): `if app.mode == .Paused {` ... `rl.DrawRectangleRec(chip, rl.Color{238, 230, 210, 255})` ... } followed by `draw_hud(&app)`; draw_hud: `draw_hud :: proc(app: ^App) {` ... `draw_tray(app)`; tray/health/forecast chips are render-package procs.
detail: The paused chip is permanent HUD furniture (styled identically to tray chips) but is the only screen-anchored HUD element drawn in main's render sequence. Minor separation-of-concerns deviation inherited from the transient overlay it replaces.
recommended_fix: Move the chip draw into draw_hud (or a small rnd.draw_paused_chip proc) so HUD chrome has one home and main stays the orchestrator.
